title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe palette to the live apps
body:
## Problem
The apps use blue and orange for the two groups; some colour-blind users cannot tell them apart.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
A palette or marker shapes that stay distinguishable for common colour-blindness types, in light and dark mode.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/app.html`, `sessions/session-03/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Both groups distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: fight overfitting with weight decay and early stopping
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's second milestone does not exist yet: Session 3 measures overfitting but does not fix it.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. The 100-hidden-neuron network on 40 noisy points has a train-test gap of 0.20.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the gap is at most 0.08
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add softmax and a three-class spiral
body:
## Problem
The network has a single sigmoid output and can only separate two classes.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 1. Softmax with the multi-class cross-entropy gives the gradient (P - Y) / N again.

## Expected outcome
A new lesson with a three-arm spiral generator, a softmax backward pass and a gradient check.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Gradient check below 1e-6
- [ ] Test accuracy at least 0.95 on a seeded three-arm spiral

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: boundary, curves and hidden layer
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a decision boundary morphing while the network trains, next to the loss and accuracy curves and the hidden-layer view. There is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] GIF of at most 3 MB with at least 40 frames
- [ ] Final training accuracy of at least 0.97
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
